newsitem.title: JAPAN: MOF Sakakibara to hold news conference on Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: MOF Sakakibara to hold news conference on Tuesday.

text.p: Eisuke Sakakibara, scheduled for promotion to Japan's vice finance minister for international affairs, will hold a news conference on Tuesday afternoon following his official appointment to the new post, the Ministry of Finance (MOF) said on Monday.
The news conference will also be attended by the outgoing MOF vice minister for international affairs, Takatoshi Kato.

Separately, a news conference will be held on Tuesday afternoon by the new and former MOF vice ministers. Current MOF vice minister Tadashi Ogawa will be replaced by Takeshi Komura, director-general of MOF's Budget Bureau.
Times for the news conferences have not been decided yet, MOF said.
Sakakibara currently heads MOF's International Finance Bureau.
